subject: Taxes
title: The Coinbase Court Order
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Coinbase Court Order.

hook.text: In 2016, the IRS asked Coinbase for records of all users who traded over $20,000. Coinbase fought back.

buildup.text: The John Doe summons targeted 14,000 Coinbase users. It was the first major legal battle over crypto tax compliance.

discovery.text: Only 800-900 people had reported Bitcoin gains that year. The IRS suspected massive underreporting—and was right.

twist.text: After the court order, crypto tax reporting surged. The threat of enforcement did what education campaigns couldn't.

climax.text: The Coinbase case established that crypto exchanges must comply with tax investigations—just like banks.

punchline.text: 800 reported, 14,000 suspected. One court order reshaped crypto tax compliance.

quiz.question: How many Coinbase users reported Bitcoin gains when the IRS investigated?
